title: RECAP: Training-Free Compensation for Coarse Activation Channel Pruning in Compressed LLMs
selection_reason: RECAP compensates training-free for coarse activation-channel pruning in compressed LLMs: it estimates the activation error from removing a channel and transfers it into the corresponding weights with grouped outlier-robust statistics, restoring LLaMA3-8B BoolQ accuracy from 38.75% to 72.48% at 70% activation-channel sparsity while keeping hardware-friendly channel sparsity.
